description: Permanently delete an assignment from a course; this cannot be undone. Returns no assignment object, only an acknowledgement that the deletion succeeded. Use update_assignment instead to change the assignment rather than remove it, or create_assignment afterward to make a new one — Canvas assigns it a new ID rather than reusing the deleted one. Requires instructor/TA permission to manage assignments and quizzes in the course.

assignment_id.description: The Canvas assignment ID to delete
